bibliographic.title: Parasym
bibliographic.author: Lethaware
bibliographic.description:
PARASYM is a raw and visceral interactive fiction. You play as a rat in the streets and sewers of Paris, and every decision shapes your fate.

Here, your choices matter. Some open doors, others come at a high price. At crucial moments, a roll of the dice puts your survival on the line. Your stats (food, health, stress, status) change throughout the story and influence what happens to you.

The narrative branches out towards 8 different endings. On the last page, a screen reveals your ending number and name, the percentage of your playthroughs that end there, and the percentage of players worldwide who achieved the same ending.

Parasym = parasite + labyrinth.

Content: animal experimentation, violence, death.
